name: @mzizi/dryv
description: Dryv contracts for the Mzizi canonical knowledge model (TypeScript authoring).

scripts.typecheck: bun run contracts:imports && bunx --bun tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run contracts:doctor && bun run contracts:compile > /dev/null && bun run engine:doctor && bun run engine:compile > /dev/null && bun run subjects:check
scripts.database:check: bun run database:typecheck && bun run database:assignments && bun tools/audit-main-domain-contracts.ts && bun tools/dry-run-main-fixtures.ts && bun run database:format:check && bun run database:doctor && bun run database:compile > /dev/null
scripts.database:format: bunx --bun @biomejs/biome format --write contracts/schemas/_shared.ts contracts/schemas/postgres/*.ts contracts/apps/api/*.ts contracts/apps/engine/*.ts contracts/apps/pgsql/*.ts package.json
scripts.database:format:check: bunx --bun @biomejs/biome format contracts/schemas/_shared.ts contracts/schemas/postgres/*.ts contracts/apps/api/*.ts contracts/apps/engine/*.ts contracts/apps/pgsql/*.ts package.json
scripts.database:typecheck: bun run contracts:imports && bunx --bun tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.database.json
